ucs.title: [LLM] Turla (Snake/Secret Blizzard) LightNeuron Exchange Transport Agent DLL drop
ucs.description: Hunts for non-Microsoft DLL or config writes into the Exchange server's TransportRoles\agents directory — the persistence mechanism unique to Turla's LightNeuron backdoor, which registers as a malicious Exchange Transport Agent to intercept inbound mail and exfiltrate via PDF/JPG-embedded commands. Documented by ESET (May 2019) as a Turla-exclusive capability with no observed reuse by other clusters.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_hash) as file_hash values(Filesystem.process_name) as process_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="*\\TransportRoles\\agents\\*" (Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.config") NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("msiexec.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","setup.exe","MSExchangeTransport.exe","ServiceHub.SettingsHost.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | where dest IN ("*EXCH*","*MAIL*","*MX*") OR file_path="*\\Exchange Server\\V15\\*"
ucs.kql:
// Turla LightNeuron — malicious Exchange Transport Agent DLL/config drop
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ExchAgentPath = @"\TransportRoles\agents\";
let TrustedInstallers = dynamic(["msiexec.exe","trustedinstaller.exe","setup.exe","msexchangetransport.exe","servicehub.settingshost.exe"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| where FolderPath has ExchAgentPath
| where FileName endswith ".dll" or FileName endswith ".config"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"     // exclude machine accounts
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (TrustedInstallers)
| where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !has "Microsoft"
   or isempty(InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Turla LightNeuron — Exchange Transport Agent persistence via ASIM file events
let LookbackDays = 14d;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where TargetFilePath has @"\TransportRoles\agents\"
| where TargetFileExtension in~ ("dll","config")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ActingProcessName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","trustedinstaller.exe","setup.exe","msexchangetransport.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, EventType, TargetFilePath, TargetFileName,
          TargetFileSHA256, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceInfo
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceName
    | project DvcHostname = DeviceName, JoinType, OSPlatform
  ) on DvcHostname
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Turla LightNeuron Exchange Transport Agent DLL Drop
id: a7c9f3e2-4b5d-4e0a-9c11-7d1a8e5f2b40
status: experimental
description: Detects non-Microsoft DLL or .config writes to the Exchange TransportRoles\agents directory, consistent with Turla's LightNeuron backdoor registering itself as a malicious Exchange transport agent for inbound email C2.
references:
    - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2019/05/07/turla-lightneuron-email-too-far/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1505.002
    - attack.command_and_control
    - attack.t1071.003
    - g0010
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: file_event
detection:
    selection_path:
        TargetFilename|contains: '\TransportRoles\agents\'
    selection_ext:
        TargetFilename|endswith:
            - '.dll'
            - '.config'
    filter_legitimate:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\msiexec.exe'
            - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
            - '\setup.exe'
            - '\MSExchangeTransport.exe'
    condition: selection_path and selection_ext and not filter_legitimate
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate third-party transport agents (Proofpoint, Trend Micro, Mimecast) — pair with software-inventory allowlist
    - Approved Exchange CU/SU rollouts (rare; verify against change ticket)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:*\\TransportRoles\\agents\\* OR @TargetFilename:*\\transportroles\\agents\\*) (@TargetFilename:*.dll OR @TargetFilename:*.DLL OR @TargetFilename:*.config OR @TargetFilename:*.CONFIG) -@Image:(*\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\MSIEXEC.EXE OR *\\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\\trustedinstaller.exe OR *\\setup.exe OR *\\MSExchangeTransport.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\\TransportRoles\\agents\\.*\.(dll|config)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/(msiexec|TrustedInstaller|setup|MSExchangeTransport|ServiceHub\.SettingsHost)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, UserName], function=([count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)]))
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Turla ComRAT v4 / PowerStallion — script interpreter or LOLBin reaching Gmail/OneDrive web UI for C2
ucs.description: Hunts for PowerShell or other non-browser script interpreters / LOLBins making outbound connections to mail.google.com, accounts.google.com or onedrive.live.com — the C2 channels Turla's ComRAT v4 (Gmail web-UI cookie-replay) and PowerStallion (OneDrive drop-folder) implants are exclusively known to use. ESET and CISA AA20-336A both attribute this dead-drop-via-consumer-cloud tradecraft to Turla.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ip values(All_Traffic.app) as app from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest IN ("mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","www.googleapis.com","onedrive.live.com","api.onedrive.com","graph.microsoft.com") OR All_Traffic.dest="*.1drv.com") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.app All_Traffic.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | search app IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Turla ComRAT v4 / PowerStallion — LOLBin or script interpreter beaconing to Gmail/OneDrive
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let TurlaC2Surfaces = dynamic([
    "mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","www.googleapis.com",
    "onedrive.live.com","api.onedrive.com","graph.microsoft.com",
    "1drv.com"
]);
let SuspiciousClients = dynamic([
    "powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe",
    "mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe",
    "curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","svchost.exe"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SuspiciousClients)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (TurlaC2Surfaces)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
// svchost is noisy — only flag when it's not the Microsoft-signed system instance brokered by a child cmdline
| where not (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "svchost.exe"
             and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("DcomLaunch","netsvcs","LocalSystemNetworkRestricted"))
| extend C2Surface = case(
    RemoteUrl has "google", "Gmail-web-UI (ComRAT v4)",
    RemoteUrl has "onedrive" or RemoteUrl has "1drv", "OneDrive (PowerStallion)",
    RemoteUrl has "graph.microsoft.com", "MS-Graph (PowerStallion variant)",
    "Other-cloud")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, C2Surface
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Turla ComRAT v4 / PowerStallion — script-interpreter beacon to consumer cloud (ASIM)
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let TurlaC2 = dynamic(["mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","www.googleapis.com","onedrive.live.com","api.onedrive.com","graph.microsoft.com","1drv.com"]);
let ScriptClients = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where HttpHostName has_any (TurlaC2) or DstHostname has_any (TurlaC2)
| union (
    ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DstHostname has_any (TurlaC2)
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcUsername, SrcHostname,
              HttpHostName=DstHostname, Url="", HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent="",
              DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber
  )
| extend ParsedAgent = tostring(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent)
| where ParsedAgent !has "Mozilla/5.0"        // exclude browser traffic
   and ParsedAgent !has "Edge/"
   and ParsedAgent !has "Chrome/"
   and ParsedAgent !has "Safari/"
| extend C2Surface = case(
    HttpHostName has "google", "Gmail-web-UI (ComRAT v4)",
    HttpHostName has "onedrive" or HttpHostName has "1drv", "OneDrive (PowerStallion)",
    HttpHostName has "graph.microsoft.com", "MS-Graph (variant)",
    "Other")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcUsername, HttpHostName, Url,
          HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, C2Surface
| order by TimeGenerated desc

| ContextImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|curl|certutil|bitsadmin)\.exe$/i

| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
